description: This source file defines the `PhotoLibraryService` class, which implements a service for fetching recent photos from the device's photo library. It includes methods for requesting authorization, rendering photo assets into JPEG format while respecting size constraints, and returning photo data with associated metadata. The class handles image resizing, quality adjustment, and encoding to conform to payload size limitations for WebSocket transmission.

classes.name: PhotoLibraryService
classes.description: A service class providing access to the photo library, allowing fetching of recent photos with constraints on size and quality for efficient transmission.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Fetches the latest photos from the user's photo library, respecting maximum payload size constraints for WebSocket transmission.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks the current authorization status for photo library access.

methods.name: renderAsset
methods.description: Converts a PHAsset into an OpenClawPhotoPayload by generating a JPEG image, resizing, and encoding while considering size and quality constraints.

methods.name: encodeJpegUnderBudget
methods.description: Encodes a UIImage into JPEG data, adjusting quality and size to fit within a specified maximum Base64-encoded size.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes a UIImage to a specified target width while maintaining aspect ratio.
